title: Red Sea state becomes two-sided while peer lane authority gains exact source-contract binding
net_new_delta: CONFIRMED_KINETIC_ESCALATION now coexists with DIPLOMATIC_OFFRAMP_ACTIVE, reducing confidence in a monotonic escalation path without confirming de-escalation or realized supply disruption. Separately, cross-repository peer ingestion now verifies exact packet-revision control-plane, agent-fabric, and MCP contract blobs and binds lane attribution to those contracts, closing a provenance gap between authentic lane blobs and authentic lane semantics.
accepted: Macro: confirmed Taiz kinetic escalation remains valid while a scheduled Riyadh political-engagement meeting creates a concrete diplomatic off-ramp.

Physical supply disruption remains unconfirmed: emergency stock releases, softer oil settlement, and improved Hormuz LNG throughput argue against treating kinetic escalation as realized energy disruption.
Peer federation: exact source-contract blob witnesses and lane-to-contract binding materially strengthen provenance and semantic authority.
rejected: Diplomatic engagement as proof of de-escalation.
Kinetic escalation as proof of Bab el-Mandeb closure or realized petroleum-flow disruption.
GitHub-native v3 deterministic liveness receipts as substantive specialist inference.
Authenticated lane blobs without verified source-contract semantics as sufficient cross-repository authority.
conflicts: Confirmed kinetic escalation versus an active diplomatic off-ramp creates a two-sided Red Sea event tree.
Military escalation versus non-confirming physical-flow/price evidence keeps realized supply disruption unresolved.
blockers: No verified Riyadh outcome, larger-offensive launch, Bab el-Mandeb traffic impairment, freight/insurance shock, or physical petroleum-flow deterioration.
Newest inspected Macro/Flow/AION/DAEDALUS/OMEGA v3 receipts are deterministic_liveness with SUBSTANTIVE_AI_INFERENCE_NOT_EXECUTED.
next_highest_value_integration_target: Make event-branch state and semantic provenance independent promotion gates: track KINETIC_ESCALATION, DIPLOMATIC_OFFRAMP, and REALIZED_SUPPLY_DISRUPTION separately; for federated evidence require exact source revision, lane blobs, source-contract blobs, contract binding, freshness, authority ceiling, and substantive freshness before analytical promotion.

athena.finding: Maintain a two-sided Red Sea event tree; kinetic escalation raises risk, but the diplomatic off-ramp and non-confirming physical-flow evidence prevent realized-disruption promotion.

janus.finding: Reconcile event branches separately and require exact source-contract plus lane-blob binding before accepting federated lane semantics.

infrastructure.finding: Peer federation now verifies packet-revision source contracts and lane attribution, while current v3 specialist receipts remain liveness-only.

helios_prime.finding: Propagate contract-bound semantic provenance across federated research while keeping liveness, substantive evidence, and execution authority non-substitutable.
